results.content:
Amazon holds an estimated 19–21% stake in Anthropic (appx. $190 billion), while Alphabet owns approximately 14% (appx. $130 billion), which makes both major beneficiaries of a successful Anthropic stock market debut. [...] ### 

Anthropic reportedly estimates its total addressable market at more than $30 trillion because it looks beyond chatbots and includes a broad range of work that could potentially be performed or assisted by AI models. The figure is higher than the $28.5 trillion TAM cited by SpaceX.

The estimate is best understood as a theoretical market opportunity rather than a revenue forecast. Its investment relevance depends on how much of that market Anthropic can realistically monetize.

### [...] ### 

Anthropic's ownership includes its founders, employees, venture investors and major strategic technology partners. Amazon is estimated to own roughly 19–21% of the company, while Alphabet holds around 14%.

These stakes make both companies potential beneficiaries of Anthropic's growth, but their own stock-market performance is still overwhelmingly determined by their much larger core businesses.

results.title: Can Anthropic Meet Its "$518 Billion of Commitments"?
results.content:
Ironically, my read on the $518B number is that it only represents Anthropic’s commitments as of June 30, 2026. As such, it fails to reflect the numerous deals outlined below that Anthropic struck after the Q2-26 quarter end, which total $191B over a weighted avg. term of 8 years, for $23B of additional annual spend.
